Directed by Hayao Miyazaki

A young witch moves to a seaside town to find her calling, loses her powers, and slowly learns what confidence really costs.

For the wobble before the good part.

Warmth, whimsy, wartime sadness.

const supabase = window.supabase.createClient( 'https://nzhzupizmfiveqedahwl.supabase.co', 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Im56aHp1cGl6bWZpdmVxZWRhaHdsIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODY0Nzc1ODIsImV4cCI6MjEwMjA1MzU4Mn0._h-zBkvjDAWQP5f4I1JVe3szByPD9mKwSnq0bv5ZFcE' ); // Cuando se carga la página, agrega listeners a cada película document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const movies = document.querySelectorAll('article.citem'); movies.forEach(movie => { movie.style.cursor = 'pointer'; movie.addEventListener('click', async () => { const title = movie.querySelector('h3').textContent; const mood = document.querySelector('[data-mood]')?.getAttribute('data-mood') || 'unknown'; await supabase.from('movie_picks').insert([{ movie_title: title, mood: mood }]); console.log('Pick guardado:', title); }); }); }); // Cargar top 10 cada 5 minutos setInterval(loadTopMovies, 300000); async function loadTopMovies() { const last24h = new Date(Date.now() - 24*60*60*1000).toISOString(); const { data } = await supabase .from('movie_picks') .select('movie_title, mood') .gte('picked_at', last24h); console.log('Top movies:', data); }
